authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FX-8 descendant-revocation both-halves initial states from permission-truth-tables.v9. v2 restores fx8Intent to the full live v9 intent and carries fx8Proves, the same truncation class as CLAUDE-FX5-SF1 / CLAUDE-FX6-SF1. It does not author a brokered-refusal record. It does not author an ambient-success observation. It does not invent a journal envelope. It does not treat the brokered half as confinement evidence. It does not execute FX-8. It does not close OBL-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-105. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-FX-AUTHORING at FX-8 without inventing refusal or observation envelopes. v2 restores the full v9 intent so the confinement-evidence failure mode is not dropped. Neither half's bytes are authored.

pttV9.fx8Intent: After revocation, a descendant process issues a brokered request (assert PR-5) AND performs the equivalent effect ambiently (assert it succeeds and that the host recorded nothing). Both assertions are mandatory. Running only the first half would produce a passing test that reads as confinement evidence, which is the failure mode this whole artifact is organized against.
pttV9.fx8Proves: ENFORCEMENT of the brokered half; DISCLOSURE of the ambient half -- and the class is INVALID if only the first half is run
